notes: Aggregates current Form W-2G box 1 winnings into the family subtotal that Schedule 1 line 8b reports (i1040gi-2025 l.6561-6575). Guards its own collect: the family must be confirmed closed (an unconfirmed family is SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED). Class boundary: gambling losses are an itemized deduction on Schedule A line 16 that this route does not compute, so when at least one Form W-2G is recorded the subtotal also reads the Schedule A gambling/other declaration (schedule-a-boundary.no-gambling-other-declared) and publishes only when it is 'yes'; 'no' (losses present) holds the subtotal and every reader of it, so losses stay refused by answer. With no W-2G recorded the declaration is not read (the shape of rule.form1040-line16 v2, ADR-0038 D1: a declaration is read inside when, never an unconditional requires). A statement with no box 1 amount recorded is not a member and adds nothing. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 1): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents, which is the figure the attachment's itemized rows add to, so the attachment ties out when a member carries cents. The line that reads it rounds once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its closure guard is unchanged.
